candidateSetNote: Every corpus pair is one candidate against one dispatch (m = 1), so the multiplicity-corrected threshold coincides with the pairwise one here. The m > 1 behaviour is measured in multiCandidate.js.

cost.note: Escalations are the human cost and are counted per 1000 GENUINELY DISTINCT actions (the population that gets escalated); judge calls are per 1000 dispatches.
